questions.text: Explain Python's Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) and how it impacts multi-threaded applications.
questions.ideal_answer: The Global Interpreter Lock is a mutex inside CPython that ensures only one thread executes Python bytecode at a time. It simplifies memory management but limits true parallelism for CPU-bound threads. I explain how it affects workload types and discuss mitigation strategies like multiprocessing or leveraging extensions that release the GIL.
questions.rationale: Senior Python roles require understanding of concurrency trade-offs. This question validates whether the candidate can reason about performance bottlenecks.
